LayoutEditor__Description: Layout Editor (port Phase 5): sheets of drawings. A sheet is a paper size with a title block, free-placed viewports onto the project's plans, elevations, sections and 3D scenes at locked scales, and its own text and dimensions. Sheets live in LayoutEditor__DrawingsData.__Sheets in project.json; snapshots and projected linework are R2 assets. Every value here is a built-in default; LayoutEditor__Config in Na__AppConfig__Main.json carries the web read-only guard. Paper distances are millimetres.

LayoutEditor__Sheet__Config.LayoutEditor__Sheet__Description: Paper. Sizes are listed landscape (long edge first); portrait swaps them. MarginMm is the border inset; the title block band sits inside the margin at the foot of the sheet. ScreenPixelsPerMm is the base on-screen size at zoom 1; printed output is driven by the PDF exporter, never by this value.

LayoutEditor__Style__Config.LayoutEditor__Style__Description: How everything printed on a sheet that is not a view is painted. Read by the chrome module, which draws the on-screen sheet and the PDF from one primitive list. FontFamily leads with Helvetica because that is what jsPDF embeds; Open Sans is the app face and metrically close enough for labels.

LayoutEditor__TitleBlock__Config.LayoutEditor__TitleBlock__Description: Two styles (D26). Modern is a vector strip: the Vale logo and one row of fields from Rows. Classic is the office's scanned title block stretched to the full sheet with the text fields overlaid at the anchors below; A4, A2 and A1 fall back to the A3 scan until their scans are added. Fields default from the project and are editable per sheet.
LayoutEditor__TitleBlock__Config.LayoutEditor__TitleBlock__ClassicFieldAn: Paper-mm anchors per paper size, measured from the top-left of the sheet, for the text overlaid on the scan. FontMm is the value size. Adjust once against the scan and every sheet follows.

LayoutEditor__Scales__Config.LayoutEditor__Scales__Description: Locked scales for 2D viewports (D27). A viewport quotes one of these; the three-way toggle on the Viewport Settings panel steps through them.

LayoutEditor__Viewport__Config.LayoutEditor__Viewport__Description: Viewports are free rectangles in paper millimetres (D29). A 2D viewport is a window onto a drawing at its scale: edge handles crop or extend the window, dragging inside pans it, corners do nothing. A 3D viewport is a raster snapshot: corners scale it proportionally, edges crop. Snapshot densities are pixels per paper millimetre on screen; the PDF exporter has its own.
LayoutEditor__Viewport__Config.LayoutEditor__Viewport__DefaultStylesNot: What a new viewport starts with. Projected Linework is off so laying out a sheet never triggers a projection; switch it on per viewport when the layout is settled, the way a raster viewport becomes a vector one in SketchUp LayOut. The raster underlay renders either way.

LayoutEditor__Text__Config.LayoutEditor__Text__Description: Sheet text (D31). Sizes are paper millimetres. Weights are the Open Sans cuts the app loads.

LayoutEditor__Dimensions__Config.LayoutEditor__Dimensions__Description: Sheet dimensions (D32) drawn in paper millimetres. A dimension placed over a 2D viewport reports paper length times the viewport's scale denominator, so it measures the model; elsewhere it reports paper millimetres. Precision is decimal places; the units suffix follows the figure.

LayoutEditor__Panels__Config.LayoutEditor__Panels__Description: The two side columns (Layers on the left; Viewport, Text, Dimensions and Styles on the right). Widths are seeded from here on first use and then remembered for the session.

LayoutEditor__Navigation__Config.LayoutEditor__Navigation__Description: Wheel zooms about the cursor; middle or right drag pans; touch pinches. Left click is for editing.

LayoutEditor__Snapping__Config.LayoutEditor__Snapping__Description: Object snaps on the projected linework inside 2D viewports, for placing and dragging sheet dimensions. RadiusPx is the pick radius on screen at any zoom. Endpoints and midpoints of every painted segment are candidates; an endpoint wins a near tie. HiddenLines adds the hidden class as a source. The toggle (toolbar button or the Snap__Toggle key binding) is remembered per browser.

LayoutEditor__History__Config.LayoutEditor__History__Description: Undo and redo per sheet. Every announced change is one step (a drag is one step); MaxSteps is how many are kept.

LayoutEditor__Selection__Config.LayoutEditor__Selection__Description: How a press finds things on the paper. HitToleranceMm is paper millimetres at 100 percent (it shrinks as you zoom in); a drag starts past DragThresholdMm; grips are drawn GripSizePx square on screen at any zoom.

LayoutEditor__Lineweights__Config.LayoutEditor__Lineweights__Description: Printed line weights in points (1 pt = 0.3528 mm), the unit a drawing office reads. These are the defaults a new sheet starts with; the Sheet panel edits them per sheet. ViewportPt is the visible projected linework; the hidden, authored and section classes keep their ratios from the Linework block.

LayoutEditor__Shapes__Config.LayoutEditor__Shapes__Description: The Draw tool's vector shapes (lines, polylines, polygons). Defaults for a new shape; the Vectors panel edits them. CloseRadiusPx is how near the first point a click has to land to close a polygon.

LayoutEditor__Enhance__Config.LayoutEditor__Enhance__Description: The Enhance Whitecard viewport style: the image export's levels and high-pass sharpen, applied to a viewport's render. A white point of 205 sends the shaded whitecard faces to paper white while the linework stays dark.

LayoutEditor__AutoSave__Config.LayoutEditor__AutoSave__Description: A browser draft of every change, put back on the next load while unsaved, and a project save of its own DebounceMs after a sheet is created, renamed, reordered or deleted. Localhost only; the web build is read-only.

LayoutEditor__Linework__Config.LayoutEditor__Linework__Description: Paper-millimetre stroke widths for the projected linework inside sheet viewports (they print at these widths at any scale). Colours follow the Projected Linework appearance block so a sheet matches its scene.

LayoutEditor__Pdf__Config.LayoutEditor__Pdf__Description: jsPDF at true paper size. 2D viewports write the projected linework, dimensions and text as vectors; underlays and 3D viewports are placed as raster images at RasterPixelsPerMm. The vendored UMD build is injected as a classic script on first use.

LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__NoSelection: Select a viewport on the sheet.
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__NoSheets: No sheets yet. Add one from the Dev menu or the + tab.
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__DeleteSheetPrompt: Delete the sheet "{name}"? Its viewports, text and dimensions go with it.
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__SnapToggleTitle: Snap dimensions to the linework endpoints and midpoints (F3)
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__EditingViewNote: Editing viewport content: drag to reposition, Esc to finish
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__DraftRestored: Unsaved sheet changes from this browser were restored. Save Sheets keeps them.
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__ShapeDefaultsNote: Nothing selected: these settings apply to new shapes.
LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.LayoutEditor__Labels__ShapeDrawNote: Draw tool (L): click points, click the first point to close a polygon, Enter or double-click to finish a line, Esc to abandon.
